composite_signal.description: Normalized composite multi-factor signal. Positive = bullish, negative = defensive.

factor_weights.description: Risk parity factor weights, normalized to sum to 1.0.

factor_contributions.description: Marginal contribution of each factor to the composite signal.

risk_parity_weight.description: Risk parity scaling factor derived from inverse volatility normalization.

recommendation.description: Actionable recommendation based on composite signal and regime context.

confidence.description: Confidence score adjusted by data freshness, factor agreement, and regime alignment.

warnings.description: Optional warnings for missing factors, stale data, or low-confidence conditions.

reasoning_trace.description: Step-by-step reasoning trace from the analysis graph.
